title: When everyone who has ever reached space got there

source.name: Astronaut/space-traveler registry
source.publisher: Association of Space Explorers, as reported by Space.com

notes: Derived split of the same cumulative registry figures used in cumulative_space_travelers.json: approximately 560 of the 750 people who have ever reached space did so before 2020 (in the program's first 59 years); the other 190 did so from 2020 through mid-2025 (roughly 5 years) as the commercial spaceflight era took off. 190/750 = 25.3%, rounded to 25% in narration.
